# CareWaste

> RCRA hazardous waste training for hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and surgery centers: generator training, satellite areas, universal waste, pharmaceutical waste guidance and first responder awareness.

CareWaste (https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA Generator Training, Satellite Accumulation, Universal Waste, Generator Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). Hazardous waste generator training for hospital EHS, pharmacy, lab and environmental services staff. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [Hazardous Waste Satellite Accumulation Area Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training): $59.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262.15. Running satellite accumulation areas in pharmacies, labs and clinical units. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training?buy=415
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Batteries, lamps, mercury devices and aerosol cans under 40 CFR 273. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA, annual). The annual RCRA refresher for healthcare staff. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training?buy=600
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Awareness-level training for staff who may discover a chemical release. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [Hazardous Waste Contingency Plan and Emergency Coordinator Training](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR Parts 262 and 264/265. Contingency plans and emergency coordinator duties for large quantity generator facilities. Enroll: https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412

## Guides

- [EPA's hazardous waste pharmaceuticals rule, in plain language](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazardous-waste-pharmaceuticals-rule): 40 CFR 266 Subpart P changed how healthcare facilities manage pharmaceutical waste. The key points.
- [Common hazardous wastes in hospitals, department by department](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/guides/common-hazardous-wastes-in-hospitals): Hazardous waste isn't just in the lab. A walk through where it's generated in a typical hospital.
- [Who in a healthcare facility needs hazardous waste training?](https://healthcare.hazwoperosha.us/guides/who-needs-hazardous-waste-training-in-healthcare): More people than you'd think. A role-by-role guide.
